description: Faction System for Athanor Ascension. 5 factions with reputation, vendors, quests, and dynamic world state.

khacs.name: KHI-ACS Academic
khacs.description: The Kavli-Helmholtz Institute for Advanced Chemical Synthesis. Tenure, grants, publications, open science.
khacs.ideology: Knowledge belongs to humanity. Safety first. Peer review is sacred.

reputation_tiers.title: Persona Non Grata
reputation_tiers.description: Banned from campus. Security escort required.

reputation_tiers.title: Under Scrutiny
reputation_tiers.description: Restricted access. Mandatory supervision.

reputation_tiers.title: Junior Fellow
reputation_tiers.description: Standard access. Basic lab privileges.

reputation_tiers.title: Research Associate
reputation_tiers.description: Extended hours. Grant eligibility. Seminar invites.

reputation_tiers.title: Principal Investigator
reputation_tiers.description: Own lab space. PhD students. Equipment budget.

reputation_tiers.title: Distinguished Professor
reputation_tiers.description: Tenure. Institute-wide influence. Committee seats.

cartel.name: Cartel Network
cartel.description: Global clandestine chemistry network. Precursors, distribution, protection, power.
cartel.ideology: Supply meets demand. Chemistry is commerce. Loyalty is currency.

reputation_tiers.title: Marked for Removal
reputation_tiers.description: Kill on sight. All safehouses burned.

reputation_tiers.title: Suspected Narc
reputation_tiers.description: No direct contact. Dead drops only.

reputation_tiers.title: Independent Cook
reputation_tiers.description: Buy precursors at market rate. No protection.

reputation_tiers.title: Trusted Operator
reputation_tiers.description: Wholesale prices. Safehouse access. Muscle available.

reputation_tiers.title: Regional Lieutenant
reputation_tiers.description: Territory control. Precursor priority. Enforcer squad.

reputation_tiers.title: Cartel Kingpin
reputation_tiers.description: Supply chain control. Political immunity. Private army.

intelligence.name: Intelligence Directorate
intelligence.description: State intelligence agency. Clearances, forensic contracts, state secrets, chemical threat reduction.
intelligence.ideology: Security through knowledge. Control through classification. Order through surveillance.

reputation_tiers.title: Person of Interest
reputation_tiers.description: Surveillance 24/7. Assets frozen. Travel banned.

reputation_tiers.title: Uncleared Contractor
reputation_tiers.description: Menial tasks. No sensitive data. Polygraph weekly.

reputation_tiers.title: Cleared Analyst
reputation_tiers.description: Secret clearance. Forensic contracts. Lab access.

reputation_tiers.title: Senior Case Officer
reputation_tiers.description: Top Secret. Field operations. Asset handling.

reputation_tiers.title: Deputy Director
reputation_tiers.description: TS/SCI. Black budget. Drone strikes authorized.

reputation_tiers.title: Director
reputation_tiers.description: Full spectrum dominance. Presidential access.

biotech.name: Biotech Consortium
biotech.description: Pharma giants, VC-backed startups, CROs. IP licensing, clinical trials, scale-up, exit strategies.
biotech.ideology: Innovation creates value. Patents protect investment. Patients wait for profit.

reputation_tiers.title: Industry Pariah
reputation_tiers.description: Blacklisted. No CRO will touch you. Patents challenged.

reputation_tiers.title: Failed Entrepreneur
reputation_tiers.description: Burned bridges. Investors blocked. Data seized.

reputation_tiers.title: Research Scientist
reputation_tiers.description: Standard salary. IP assignment. Publication rights limited.

reputation_tiers.title: Principal Scientist
reputation_tiers.description: Team lead. Bonus structure. Conference circuit.

reputation_tiers.title: VP Research
reputation_tiers.description: Portfolio control. M&A influence. Board access.

reputation_tiers.title: CSO / Founder
reputation_tiers.description: Equity stake. IPO trajectory. Industry legend.

aetherkin.name: Aetherkin Clans
aetherkin.description: Mythic alchemical beings. Transcendence through chemistry. The old ways, rediscovered.
aetherkin.ideology: Matter is memory. Chemistry is consciousness. The Athanor awakens.

reputation_tiers.title: Uninitiated
reputation_tiers.description: Blind to the Great Work. Mundane perception only.

reputation_tiers.title: Seeker
reputation_tiers.description: First visions. Dreams of structures. Sensitivity to resonance.

reputation_tiers.title: Apprentice Alchemist
reputation_tiers.description: Companion bond. Minor transmutations. Dream guidance.

reputation_tiers.title: Adept
reputation_tiers.description: Multiple companions. Catalyst synthesis. Astral projection.

reputation_tiers.title: Magister
reputation_tiers.description: Mythic companion. Reality bending. Time perception.

reputation_tiers.title: Archmagus / Athanor Ascended
reputation_tiers.description: Chrysalis Warden bond. Causality manipulation. Immortality.

lab_control.description: Factions compete for control of laboratory facilities

control_effects.controlling_faction: Discounted access, priority scheduling, exclusive equipment
control_effects.contested: Higher prices, random inspections, sabotage risk

market_prices.description: Precursor and reagent prices fluctuate by faction control

npc_attitudes.description: NPC dialogue and behavior change based on faction standing
